notes.text: Blitz Split now speaks German, Italian and Polish: it follows your device's language, or you can pick one in Profile › Language.
Every category now has its own color, and Statistics draws each category and each person in theirs.
You can now change a category's color, in the category's form or in Category map.
A bill's menu on Expenses has a new option, Duplicate: it opens a new bill already filled in like the original.
Groups and bills no longer disappear for a moment when you come back to the app.
Search no longer closes right away when you don't have a group yet.
A new group now starts as Event, the first type on the list.
With no group yet, Invite with link or QR now shows only the New group button instead of buttons you couldn't use.
A receipt that takes longer to read no longer ends in a connection error.
Statistics' category rows are cleaner: they no longer list each subcategory's amount.
